description: Add multi-API fallback to PublicSource so that if mempool.space is rate-limited or unreachable, the miner automatically retries with blockstream.info (and any further fallbacks). The rest of the codebase must not need changes beyond what is strictly required.
steps: 1. In minerador/public_source.py, replace the single `API = 'https://mempool.space/api'` constant with an ordered list: `APIS = ['https://mempool.space/api', 'https://blockstream.info/api']`. Keep `API = APIS[0]` so controller.py's `from .public_source import API as MEMPOOL_API` import still works without changes.
2. Add an instance variable `self._api_index = 0` in PublicSource.__init__ to track which API is currently active.

3. Rewrite `PublicSource._get(path, as_json)` so that it tries each API in APIS in order. On HTTP 429 or any connection/HTTP error for the current API, rotate to the next one (wrapping around) and retry — up to len(APIS) full rotations total before raising. Keep the existing 3-attempt retry-on-429 logic but apply it per-API endpoint attempt, not globally. Log (via self.log) when switching APIs so the operator can see it in the event log.
4. Update `self.tip['api']` or add a helper property `active_api` that returns `APIS[self._api_index]` — this is optional but useful for status().
5. Update the `status()` method to include a new key `'api_ativa'` set to `APIS[self._api_index]`, so the UI and /api/status can show which API is in use.

6. Ensure the `_loop` method still sets `self.connected = True` and `self.error = None` on success, and `self.connected = False` with a descriptive error on total failure. The log message on success should mention the active API name.

7. Run the existing test suite (.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/test_regtest.py) and confirm all 27 tests still pass. The test_controller.py fixture creates a PublicSource directly — make sure the constructor signature is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The module-level `API` constant still exists and equals 'https://mempool.space/api' so controller.py's import does not break.
PublicSource constructor signature is unchanged (no new required arguments).
All 27 existing tests pass when running: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/test_regtest.py
The status() dict includes a new 'api_ativa' key.

When the server is started and /api/status is queried, 'conectado' is true (network permitting) — verifiable by running: pkill -f run.py; sleep 1; .venv/bin/python run.py --sem-navegador & sleep 8; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/status | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('conectado'), d.get('fonte',{}).get('api_ativa'))" ; pkill -f run.py
verification: pkill -f run.py; sleep 1; .venv/bin/python run.py --sem-navegador & sleep 10; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/status; pkill -f run.py
